summary.en: Alleges visa abuse and hiring discrimination without a fee position.

summary.zh: 批评企业外包及替代美国员工，未表达收费立场。
summary.en: Criticizes offshoring and displacement without a fee position.

summary.zh: 要求撤回或降低并按企业规模收费。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal or lower size-based fees.

summary.zh: 反对收费推动软件岗位及美国培养人才外流。
summary.en: Opposes offshoring of software jobs and loss of U.S.-trained talent.

summary.zh: 询问境内转身份及高校申请是否适用收费。
summary.en: Asks whether in-country status changes and university petitions face the fee.

summary.zh: 要求十五万至五十万美元分级费及更多工作限制。
summary.en: Requests tiered $150,000–$500,000 fees and further employment restrictions.

summary.zh: 要求撤回，质疑法律与收入模型及累积成本。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal over legal authority, revenue modeling and cumulative costs.

summary.zh: 认为无需引进外劳，未表达收费立场。
summary.en: Says foreign recruitment is unnecessary without a fee position.

summary.zh: 有条件支持仅向首次受益人收费，保护既有 H-1B 工作者。
summary.en: Conditionally supports fees only for first-time beneficiaries while protecting established H-1B workers.

summary.zh: 认为提案不足并要求终结项目，未明确认可收费。
summary.en: Finds the proposal insufficient and seeks program abolition without endorsing the fee.

summary.zh: 反对初创企业无法承受且损害创新的费用。
summary.en: Opposes fees unaffordable for startups and harmful to innovation.

summary.zh: 反对提高美国专业工作成本并促使业务迁出。
summary.en: Opposes making specialized U.S. work costlier and encouraging relocation.

summary.zh: 批评收费破坏毕业生路径、损害小企业并增加既有负担。
summary.en: Criticizes disruption to graduate pathways, smaller firms and existing burdens.

summary.zh: 主张灵活签证规则并关注外包，未明确评价收费。
summary.en: Favors flexible visa rules and flags offshoring without evaluating the fee.

summary.zh: 认为政策妨碍人才招聘并减少留学生及教育收入。
summary.en: Argues the policy hinders talent recruitment and reduces international enrollment and education revenue.

summary.zh: 要求撤回，质疑权限与收入并主张学生及小企业保护。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal over authority and revenue and protections for students and small firms.

summary.zh: 要求撤回，担心创新、岗位及美国培养人才外流。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal over losses of innovation, jobs and U.S.-trained talent.

summary.zh: 支持雇主付费以优先保障美国人就业。
summary.en: Supports employer fees to prioritize American employment.

summary.zh: 支持规则以降低企业偏好廉价外劳的动机。
summary.en: Supports the rule to reduce incentives favoring cheaper foreign labor.

summary.zh: 支持收费防欺诈并筛选真正专业岗位。
summary.en: Supports fees to prevent fraud and select genuinely specialized roles.

summary.zh: 反对无关成本转嫁及对小企业和创新的损害。
summary.en: Opposes unrelated cost shifting and harms to small employers and innovation.

summary.zh: 支持收费并主张美国公民就业优先。
summary.en: Supports the fee and American-citizen hiring priority.

summary.zh: 批评跨机构收费越权并认为无法阻止外包。
summary.en: Challenges authority for interagency fees and argues they will not stop offshoring.

summary.zh: 批评政策加剧工程及医疗人才短缺。
summary.en: Criticizes the policy for worsening engineering and medical talent shortages.

summary.zh: 明确反对拟议规则。
summary.en: Explicitly opposes the proposed rule.

summary.zh: 感谢保护美国工资并希望更高收费。
summary.en: Welcomes protection of American wages and wishes for higher fees.

summary.zh: 提出让 EB-5 投资移民也分担费用。
summary.en: Suggests including EB-5 investors among fee payers.

summary.zh: 支持至少十万美元费用并夸张地要求进一步提高。
summary.en: Supports at least $100,000 and hyperbolically seeks further increases.

summary.zh: 支持征税限制 H-1B 仅用于本土人才短缺岗位。
summary.en: Supports charging H-1Bs to restrict use to domestic skill shortages.

summary.zh: 反对规则对赴美学生的不利影响。
summary.en: Opposes the rule's harm to students studying in the United States.

summary.zh: 要求更高且年度重复收费以限制滥用。
summary.en: Requests higher recurring annual fees to constrain abuse.

summary.zh: 要求撤回，认为外流削弱税基并使收入模型失效。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal, arguing offshoring erodes the tax base and revenue model.

summary.zh: 同意收费，但更希望关闭项目。
summary.en: Agrees with the fee while preferring program closure.

summary.zh: 要求撤回，反对跨机构成本转嫁及不可靠收入预测。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal over interagency cost shifting and unreliable revenue forecasts.

summary.zh: 要求大幅涨费及汇款征税，未明确评价拟议金额。
summary.en: Seeks steep fees and remittance taxes without evaluating the proposed amount.

summary.zh: 要求撤回和延长评论期，指出小企业及毕业生受损。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal and a longer comment period, citing small-firm and graduate harms.

summary.zh: 反对高费阻碍初创企业投资年轻人才。
summary.en: Opposes the high fee as a barrier to startups investing in young talent.

summary.zh: 警告政策破坏美国科技及人工智能竞争力。
summary.en: Warns the policy would damage U.S. technology and AI competitiveness.

summary.zh: 反对关闭人才通道并要求充分经济评估。
summary.en: Opposes barriers to talent and calls for fuller economic review.

summary.zh: 要求撤回统一费，改用按工资和地区定向监管。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal of the flat fee in favor of wage- and location-based oversight.

summary.zh: 认为收费将美国培养的科技人才送往竞争国家。
summary.en: Argues the fee would transfer U.S.-trained scientific talent to competitors.

summary.zh: 要求撤回并提出较低费用及美国研究生豁免。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal and proposes lower fees and U.S. graduate-degree exemptions.

summary.zh: 要求撤回或合理修改，避免小企业及美国团队受损。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal or proportional revision to protect small firms and U.S. teams.

summary.zh: 要求按市场工资两倍浮动收费并扩大适用范围。
summary.en: Requests a floating fee at twice market salary and broader coverage.

summary.zh: 支持费用促进美国经济及就业。
summary.en: Supports the fee for the U.S. economy and job market.

summary.zh: 要求撤回并逐项证明跨系统成本的授权及关联。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal and itemized authority and nexus for system-wide costs.

summary.zh: 支持收费鼓励招聘本土人才。
summary.en: Supports the fee to encourage domestic recruitment.

summary.zh: 反对将高技能签证变为巨额收费工具。
summary.en: Opposes turning skilled-worker visas into a large revenue charge.

summary.zh: 反对提案并要求延长评论期及完整经济数据。
summary.en: Opposes the proposal and seeks a longer comment period and full economic data.

summary.zh: 反对进一步涨费，要求保持可负担的人才通道。
summary.en: Opposes further increases and seeks affordable access to global talent.

summary.zh: 认为高费损害经济，主张直接打击工资及雇主欺诈。
summary.en: Argues the fee harms the economy and favors direct action against wage and employer fraud.

summary.zh: 要求撤回，警告外包及美国培养人才流失。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal over offshoring and loss of U.S.-trained talent.

summary.zh: 认为收费无效，要求取消工作签证。
summary.en: Rejects the fee as ineffective and calls for ending work visas.

summary.zh: 未表达政策立场，仅表示不愿阅读。
summary.en: Expresses unwillingness to read without a policy position.

summary.zh: 反对高费阻碍小企业及国际毕业生就业。
summary.en: Opposes barriers to small employers and international-graduate employment.

summary.zh: 明确赞成拟议修改。
summary.en: Explicitly favors the proposed changes.

summary.zh: 认为收费会推动外包，要求补充分析后再决定。
summary.en: Argues the fee would encourage offshoring and demands further analysis before finalization.

summary.zh: 反对损害小企业招聘，并主张加强非法用工核查。
summary.en: Opposes small-business recruitment harms and favors stronger unlawful-employment checks.

summary.zh: 要求撤回并延长评论期，质疑权限及收入依据。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal and a longer comment period over authority and revenue assumptions.

sourceNote.zh: 正文保留未填写的模板提示；分类依据已有论述，未补写缺失内容。
sourceNote.en: The body retains an unfilled template prompt; classification uses the supplied arguments without inventing missing content.

summary.zh: 呼吁按能力平等招聘，未明确评价收费。
summary.en: Calls for equal merit-based hiring without evaluating the fee.

summary.zh: 反驳岗位一对一替代假设，警告投资和工作外移。
summary.en: Rejects one-for-one job substitution assumptions and warns of relocation.

summary.zh: 指控虚假学历和项目滥用，未表明收费立场。
summary.en: Alleges false credentials and program abuse without a fee position.

summary.zh: 要求撤回，指出越权、外流及劳动者议价风险。
summary.en: Seeks withdrawal over authority, offshoring and worker bargaining risks.

summary.zh: 认为费用无法解决本土就业问题且推动外包。
summary.en: Argues the fee will not solve domestic employment concerns and encourages offshoring.

summary.zh: 认为收费减少滥用并增加美国毕业生就业。
summary.en: Sees the fee as reducing abuse and increasing jobs for American graduates.

description.zh: 涉及美国劳动者的岗位替代、工资压力、招聘优先或培训。
description.en: Discusses displacement, wage pressure, hiring priority or training of U.S. workers.

description.zh: 提出或回应欺诈、项目滥用、招聘歧视、工资执法及核查问题。
description.en: Raises or addresses fraud, program abuse, recruitment discrimination, wage enforcement or verification.

codebook.zh: 要求更高费用或更严签证限制
codebook.en: Higher fees or tighter visa limits

description.zh: 要求超过提案的收费、扩大征收范围、重复收费或进一步限制／取消签证。
description.en: Seeks a higher fee, broader coverage, recurring charges or further visa restrictions or abolition.

description.zh: 担忧收费或既有办理成本、企业承受力以及付费门槛造成的不平等。
description.en: Expresses concern about fees or existing processing costs, affordability or unequal access based on ability to pay.

description.zh: 担忧技术人才、创业、创新、投资或相关岗位因收费流失。
description.en: Warns of losing skilled talent, entrepreneurship, innovation, investment or related jobs because of the fee.

codebook.zh: 收费权限、成本分摊与收入

description.zh: 讨论法律路径、跨部门成本分摊、公共财政、收费或收入测算。
description.en: Discusses the legal route, interagency cost allocation, public finances or fee and revenue estimates.

codebook.zh: 差异化收费、豁免或替代措施

description.zh: 提出按规模、工资、用工模式或合规风险收费、豁免，或用针对性执法替代统一收费。
description.en: Proposes fees or exemptions based on size, wages, hiring model or compliance risk, or targeted enforcement instead of a uniform fee.

codebook.zh: 在美学生与既有教育投入

description.zh: 提到在美就读、美国培养的毕业生、教育投入或从学生身份转向工作的影响。
description.en: Mentions current U.S. study, U.S.-educated graduates, educational investment or the transition from study to work.
